fields.label: Tier Name
fields.description: License tier name, such as Starter, Professional, or Enterprise.

fields.label: Max Partners
fields.description: Maximum number of partners allowed for the license tier.

fields.label: Max Deals Per Month
fields.description: Maximum number of deals allowed per month for the license tier.

fields.label: Max AI Requests
fields.description: Maximum number of AI requests allowed for the license tier.

fields.label: Max MDF Requests
fields.description: Maximum number of MDF requests allowed for the license tier.

fields.label: Enable AI
fields.description: Indicates whether AI functionality is available for the license tier.

fields.label: Enable MDF
fields.description: Indicates whether MDF functionality is available for the license tier.

fields.label: Enable Analytics
fields.description: Indicates whether analytics functionality is available for the license tier.

fields.label: Enable Webhooks
fields.description: Indicates whether webhooks are available for the license tier.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Indicates whether the license tier configuration is enabled.
